Facility: Doha West Power and Distillation Plant, Kuwait City
Description: Missile or drone strike on the service building of the Doha West power and water complex on the night of 29 to 30 March 2026. Significant material damage reported; one Indian worker killed; nationwide water supply reported as stable. Confirmed through cross-reporting (Al Jazeera, 2026b; The National, 2026; TRT World, 2026). Attribution disputed: Iran implicated by Kuwaiti and US sources; Iran blamed Israel.
